subject: Recap + unit-econ scenarios for LumaCare feature (tokens, $/1M, payback)
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@lumacare.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Josh Park <josh@lumacare.ai>, procurement@lumacare.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Great call — summary and a few clarifying Qs

Hi Neha / Soojin —

Thanks for the walkthrough today, appreciate the clarity on latency and the Dedicated options. Quick recap from our side and 3 follow ups so we can sharpen economics: 

1) Volume signals: we ran an internal estimate and expect the new summarization feature to see ~120k calls/month initially with a conservative ramp to ~600k calls/month in 9 months if a pilot converts. Average tokens per call ~2,400 (prompt+response).

2) Decision timeline: procurement to present to leadership week of July 5. Budget range is flexible but procurement asked us to target a TCO envelope (including hosting + vendor fees) no higher than $65k/month for the feature at steady state (approx. 600k calls/month).

3) Security: we confirmed they need VPC/private deployment and audit log retention 12 months.

Clarifying Qs:
- Can you give a 3-tier pricing/ops scenario (pilot / steady-state / optimized) with explicit $/1M token targets and an example $/feature number?
- Any assumptions you make about average tokens/response latency tradeoffs that materially affect unit cost?

I've attached our requirements workbook — it has the current feature spec and traffic assumptions.

Next steps: we can share an internal cost worksheet and a short pricing proposal that maps to our pilot (3 months) + scale (9–12 months) expectations. Can you have a draft by Monday (Jun 21)?

Thanks,
Elena
Product Lead — LumaCare

Attachments: LumaCare_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@lumacare.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Great call — summary and a few clarifying Qs

Elena —

Appreciate the clear notes and the workbook. Quick internal plan: Soojin and I will draft a 3-scenario commercial outline (Pilot / Steady / Optimized) that includes explicit $/1M token figures, per-feature math and a CAC payback snapshot. Vivek will attach a short cost model so you can see the assumptions that drive the $/1M.

High level acknowledgements: VPC + 12mo logs supported in Private deployment, SLA draft attached for procurement to review. We also noted your budget target (~$65k/mo at 600k calls). We'll map that to token-level pricing and a recommended packaging approach (per-call vs monthly seat + tokens).

Promise: draft by Monday EOD (Jun 21 PT). Quick asks to make our numbers sharper: could you confirm whether the "2,400 tokens per call" is median or 95th pct? If you can paste a small sample of 10 calls (anonymized) into the workbook that helps a lot.

Thanks —
Neha
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SLA_draft_LumaCare.pdf (stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: initial unit-econ sketches for LumaCare (3 scenarios)

FYI — I sketched three clean scenarios below. I'm pasting the working notes so the team can pick numbers to surface to the customer. These are conservative - build in a 10% margin cushion for unknowns (latency spikes, token variance).

--- WORKING NOTES ---
Assumptions from call: 2,400 avg tokens/call (we'll treat as median for baseline), pilot 120k calls/mo -> 288M tokens/mo? (calculation note: 120k * 2,400 = 288,000,000 tokens/month) ; steady-state 600k calls/mo -> 1.44B tokens/mo.

Redwood incremental inference cost (hosted runtime, mixed precision, with KV caching) estimates: 
- Cost to Redwood (infrastructure + maintenance) 
  - baseline inference cost: $35 per 1M tokens (pilot tooling + cache benefit assumed)
  - optimized (quantization + batch tuning): $18 per 1M tokens

Suggested list price bands to customer (per 1M tokens):
- Pilot (3 months): $280 / 1M tokens (small commitment, higher margin)
- Steady (month-to-month at scale): $160 / 1M tokens (committed capacity discounts)
- Optimized reserved (annual reserved / Dedicated + quantized models): $95 / 1M tokens

Per-feature economics (example using median tokens):
- Pilot cost per call to Redwood: (2,400 / 1,000,000) * $35 = $0.084 per call
- Pilot list price per call: (2,400 / 1,000,000) * $280 = $0.672 per call
- Steady cost per call: (2,400 / 1,000,000) * $35 = $0.084 (note: cost to Redwood decreases with optimization; shown below)
- Steady list price per call: (2,400 / 1,000,000) * $160 = $0.384 per call
- Optimized cost per call (Redwood cost $18/1M): $0.0432 per call; list price @ $95/1M = $0.228 per call

Per-feature per-MAU math (if 3 calls/user/month):
- Pilot: 3 * $0.672 = $2.016 per MAU/month price -> cost to Redwood = 3 * $0.084 = $0.252 -> gross margin ~87.5%
- Steady: price 3 * $0.384 = $1.152 per MAU/month -> cost = $0.252 -> gross margin ~78.1%
- Optimized reserved: price 3 * $0.228 = $0.684 per MAU/month -> cost = 3 * $0.0432 = $0.1296 -> gross margin ~81.0%

CAC payback examples (assume LumaCare attaches feature to $8/month ARPU incremental per converted customer; Redwood partner economics are illustrative):
- If LumaCare's CAC for users attributable to the feature is $20: 
  - Pilot pricing: payback = 20 / 2.016 ~ 9.9 months
  - Steady pricing: payback = 20 / 1.152 ~ 17.4 months
  - Optimized pricing: payback = 20 / 0.684 ~ 29.2 months

Observations: to hit LumaCare procurement target of ~$65k/mo at 600k calls (1.44B tokens):
- Target unit price required = 65,000 / 600,000 = $0.1083 per call -> per 1M tokens equivalent = (0.1083 / 2,400) * 1,000,000 = $45.1 / 1M tokens.
- That maps close to our "optimized reserved" cost band; i.e., to meet $65k/mo TCO they would need a reserved/annual commitment and aggressive model/ops optimization.

Risks and contiguity: token variance (95th pct > 4,000 tokens) or higher call frequency will push costs above the TCO target. Recommend we model a 10% headroom and include a fallback pricing clause.

Action: I'll attach a simple cost model spreadsheet (Redwood_inference_cost_model.xlsx) with these bands and allow procurement to tweak token distribution.

-Vivek

Attachments: Redwood_inference_cost_model.xlsx (working model)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: initial unit-econ sketches for LumaCare (3 scenarios)

Nice breakdown, Vivek — a couple of commercial notes to surface to Elena for procurement:

1) Packaging: Given LumaCare's preference for predictable TCO, propose a two-line item: (A) Reserved token block (annual, 1.44B tokens) priced at $95/1M and (B) Overage band at $160/1M. This makes steady-state math predictable and gives them upside if usage spikes.

2) CAC/payback framing for leadership: show two lenses — payback (months to recover CAC) and margin per MAU. For procurement, they care about absolute TCO; for product leadership they care about payback and conversion lift. We'll prepare a one-pager with the three scenarios paired to the decision owners (procurement / product / finance).

3) Ask list for procurement: a) anonymized token samples (10–20) b) confirmation on retention/PII handling c) expected rollout schedule if pilot succeeds (Q3 pilot -> Q4 roll).

I'll draft the one-pager and attach to the Monday delivery.

-Marissa
Enterprise GTM — Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena@lumacare.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + unit-econ scenarios for LumaCare feature (tokens, $/1M, payback)

Thanks all — this is exactly what procurement needed to see. A few quick replies: 

- The 2,400 tokens/call figure is median; 95th pct is ~3,900. We'll upload a 10-sample anonymized payload to the workbook tonight.
- Procurement likes the reserved+overage packaging — please include a line for 12-month ledgered commitment and a suggested SLA credit structure.
- Timeline: we can review your one-pager with leadership on July 6. Pilot start target: Aug 2.

Please include a short note in the one-pager about how caching (prefix caching of repeated prompts) is assumed in the $18-$35 cost bands — procurement will want to know what we need to do during pilot to realize those gains.

Appreciate the rapid turn. We'll expect the Monday deck.

Best,
Elena
